title: `FIRST_VALUE` and `LAST_VALUE` default to the whole partition
verdict: aggregates take SQL's default frame; value functions the partition; `LAG` needs `ORDER BY`
description: With an `ORDER BY` and no frame, `SUM` and `COUNT` take `RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`, peers included. `FIRST_VALUE` and `LAST_VALUE` instead take the whole partition: `LAST_VALUE(x) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x)` is the partition's last value on every row, where SQL's default frame gives the current peer group's.
`LAG` and `LEAD` need an `ORDER BY`, take the default past the partition, and `IGNORE NULLS`. `RANGE` frames with offsets work on numbers.
reference: Window functions over the frame the plan states. sverify's SQL writes every frame out (`over_frame`) and every `LAG`, `LEAD` with an `ORDER BY`.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT p, x, sum(x) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), sum(x) OVER (PARTITION BY p), first_value(x) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), last_value(x) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES (1, 1), (1, 1), (1, 2), (1, NULL), (2, 5)) AS s(p, x) ORDER BY p, x NULLS LAST

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
